title: General window frames repeatedly aggregate the whole frame.

proposal_metadata.scope: COUNT, machine-integer SUM, and bounded ROWS MIN/MAX for admitted scalar types.
validation_required: Native ROWS/RANGE boundaries, empty and all-null frames, both directions and peer values.
Signed/unsigned accumulator wrap with required, optional and narrow integral inputs.
Queue-row type agrees with private count output and public output layout excludes auxiliaries.
Fallback SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX and whole/running/suffix frame paths retain ordered behavior.
COUNT/integer-SUM-only general frames have no reachable Fold/Fold1 and scale independently of frame width.
retained_fallbacks: Floating, Decimal and Interval SUM; AVG

checks: Bounded ROWS MIN/MAX two-stack amendment independently source-reviewed; model evidence is not native verification
verification_limitation: Source and model checks only. The scoped implementation covers COUNT, machine-integer SUM and admitted total-order scalar MIN/MAX across general ROWS/RANGE frames, including suffixes. Compilation, native semantics, cancellation and actual memory/work scaling remain pending. Unsupported types/functions keep their original fold. Mixed RANGE windows use two collectors and require explicit memory/latency acceptance.
scope_rationale: Original Q01 permits general fallback where incremental evaluation is not admitted; ROWS/RANGE frame-shape gaps are closed for the explicitly supported scalar MIN/MAX family. Broader type coverage is not claimed.

previous: General RANGE MIN/MAX and unbounded general-frame MIN/MAX where not handled by existing specialized paths
resolved_implementation_scope.scope: The explicitly admitted scalar MIN/MAX family; conservative type/function fallback retained.
